gaps: The nebula-eye payoff and widely tracked caps lean on familiar space-documentary clichés. A less expected final image would raise originality
Credit type is a fairly generic geometric sans in small caps. A more distinctive face would give the titles more character
Some cosmic plates read as stock-like composites. More bespoke, consistent CG would match the tactile quality of the sand and rock shots

defects: The ripple warp breaks letterforms into doubled, smeared glyphs ('LISTHETEN', 'VOI:SE'). The distortion looks like a displacement-map artifact, not a designed deformation.
Key words run off frame ('SOU', 'NOISE' clipped left and right), so the opening frames read as bad framing rather than a deliberate crop.
Small mono captions sit low-left on busy, dark, defocused ground with weak contrast, and they are placed the same way on every beat.
The white SILENCE section is flat and nearly static from about 22s to 30s. It is a slow push-in on grey type, with roughly 6s of dead air past the payoff.
The light-state ring has a noisy, striated texture that doesn't match the polished metal ring in the dark section.
The camera is one continuous drifting move with no change of lens or scale. All the variety has to come from the surface ripples.
gaps: Motion: everything comes from a continuous liquid displacement plus a slow camera drift. There are no struck accents, no anticipation or settle on the ring 'listening' and flipping, and the FLIP beat (the core mechanism, the anti-phase wave) never visibly shows two waves meeting and cancelling. Top studio work would choreograph that collision as the hero moment.

Sound: it reads as generated design: a broadband noise bed, a mid-film noise swell, rising pure sine sweeps, then a hard cut to digital silence and a sparse sine-partial chime. There is no produced low end, no foley texture for air or pressure, and no layered dynamics. The cut to silence is effective, but it is the only real sync point.

Finish and pacing: the release overstays its welcome, and the dark-to-light transition is a single frame switch (the 138 spike) with no built transition. The warped type needs art-directed distortion that keeps the words legible, and the final 6s needs a closing move or a rhyme with the opening ripple instead of a static hold.
